summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Poker Club app. All 14 backend API tests passed. All critical frontend flows verified: profile selection, PIN entry, login, lobby, poker table, profile screen, logout, admin panel with chip distribution.

issues: Profile cards appear blank/dark in second screenshot - likely SSR initial render issue, resolves on hydration

react_native_issues.issue: useNativeDriver warning in web: 'RCTAnimation module is missing'. Cosmetic/warning only, shake animation falls back to JS
shadow* style props deprecated warning, use boxShadow instead

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow for React Native Web compatibility
OPTIONAL: Use useNativeDriver: false for web-targeted shake animation or guard with Platform.OS check
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS allows_origins=["*"] with allow_credentials=True - this combination may be rejected by some browsers (credentials+wildcard origin). Should use explicit origins for production.
server.py: JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback default - acceptable for dev but should be required in production
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows working. Backend: auth login, /api/players (7 users), /api/admin/distribute-chips all functional. Frontend: select-profile (7 cards), PIN modal, login navigation, lobby with WS presence, poker table screen, profile screen, admin panel with chip distribution all verified.
